statement: let roots := fun a q : ℕ => (Finset.range q).filter (fun r => q ∣ r^2+a); ∀ (q : ℕ) [NeZero q], ∃ e : {r : ℕ // r ∈ roots 1 q} ≃ {u : ZMod q // u^2+1=0}, ∀ r, (e r).1.val = r.1

plain_statement.zh: 新路线 · Levent GRH 与自然扩张 · QP-0010 · 在标准代表与模环根集之间保留根标签
plain_statement.en: New route · Levent GRH and natural extensions · QP-0010 · Transport labelled roots between representatives and ZMod

brief.zh: 用标准代表的 val 和自然数嵌入构造互逆映射，给傅里叶系数保留根的位置。
brief.en: Build inverse maps with val and the natural cast to retain the location of each root.
